units.source_text: “那家人待我很好。孩子哭了，内掌柜就怕吵醒我，把他背到外面去。我有时甚至想：我这是替人做工吗？

en.t: That family treats me very well. When the child cries, the mistress of the house worries he will wake me and carries him outside. Sometimes I even wonder: is this really what it means to work for someone?

units.source_text: 没什么不满意的，只是把睡铺铺得歪歪斜斜，有点不称心。

en.t: I have no real complaints; it is just that when my bedding is laid out crookedly, it bothers me a little.

units.source_text: 回来晚了，他们给我铺好。

en.t: When I come back late, they lay it out for me.

units.source_text: 要么是褥子摞得不整齐，要么就是床单铺得歪歪斜斜。

en.t: Either the bedding is not stacked neatly, or the sheet is spread out crookedly.

units.source_text: 一看到这个样子，不禁可怜起自己来。

en.t: Whenever I see it like that, I cannot help feeling sorry for myself.

units.source_text: 可是自己又不好重新再铺过，只怕辜负了人家的一番好意啊。”

en.t: But I cannot very well remake it myself, for fear of wasting their kind intentions.
